text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gradually, my understanding deepened, and 
I began to slowly grasp what Neo Universe 
was trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, she warns that a crisis 
will befall Zenno Rob Roy's debut race. 
And that crisis is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—It became reality. Following the lottery 
results, Zenno Rob Roy was unable to enter 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How had Neo Universe predicted it? As the 
things they could understand grew, the 
unfathomable mysteries grew along with 
them.
